notes.title: Nimble Quest resolution support update!
notes.content: In the latest update we have added the ability to play at any resolution as well as improved fullscreen support. The game window can now be re-sized using the mouse to whatever size will fit on your monitor. Happy Nimble Questing in your new, bigger game world!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Nimble Quest
notes.content:
Nimble Quest is Now Available on Steam!

Nimble Quest! Lead a conga line of heroes to glory against hordes of enemies across an endless number of stages. How many enemies can you defeat? Steer your unstoppable (seriously, you can’t stop) party as they cut a path of destruction through levels filled with different enemies and power-ups. Unlock and level up heroes to increase the size of your party and make them more powerful.
Tired of competing alone? Join a guild and compete with other players in special time-limited Guild Quests. Is your guild skilled enough to top the global leaderboards?
